label: The Treta Yuga
summary: Second of the four ages. Tradition gives it 1,296,000 years with twilights, and dharma on three legs. The age is the setting of the Ramayana tradition.

label: Dharma on three legs
summary: In Treta, tradition says the bull of dharma stands on three legs, cleanliness, compassion and truth, and has lost austerity.

label: Vamana, the dwarf avatar
summary: Vamana is fifth in the common list of avatars and is placed in the Treta age. The Puranic story tells of three steps that measure the worlds.

label: Parashurama, the sage-warrior avatar

label: Rama, the seventh avatar
